extraction.notes: EQR reports FFO and Normalized FFO only; no AFFO, so affo fields are null. FFO (333,646) is before preferred distributions (772); the FFO available to Common Shares and Units (332,874) is a later subtotal and was not used as ffo_total. Normalized FFO (341,984) is before preferred distributions as well. Preferred distributions are not included in the adjustment lists. Depreciation – Partially Owned Properties is classed as re_depreciation. The 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' line was classed as 'other' because it does not clearly match a listed category. Unconsolidated operating-asset gain is printed as an em dash for the current quarter (recorded as 0). Diluted shares 390,664 reproduces reported per-share figures: 332,874/390,664 = 0.85 FFO; 341,212/390,664 = 0.87 Normalized FFO. Recurring capex is from the Capital Expenditures to Real Estate table (quarter, total column 55,392), since EQR's FFO-based metrics do not deduct it.
